finite_matrix.limits: Parser rows cover literal insertion only. Inference rows describe cached-type construction, not declaration validity. axis_refinement.reason: Source establishes cache-name presence, not declaration presence, as the reconstruction helper prerequisite. Refine the frozen symbol/declaration-prerequisite wording explicitly; do not silently equate names with declarations.
axis_refinement.states: Two cache-name states, one declaration-map state (empty). This replaces the initially considered absent-names/declarations versus present-names/declarations reading; it does not add a third mixed state.
axis_refinement.execution_condition: Record this exact axis clarification in canonical source assessment/design before a later separately gated implementation. No implementation or experiment occurred during this review.

source_findings.finding: Separate flags default false; configuration validation does not require Nat when String is true. README does not describe a cross-extension dependency or guarantee full support for each mixed configuration.

Parser NatLit insertion gates only Nat; StrLit insertion gates only String. Quick constructors likewise follow their own flag/storage. Configure before constructing both permanent and temporary DAGs; post-construction flag toggles are not equivalent.

NameCache resolves interned hierarchical names, not declarations. Literal inference manufactures Const(Nat,[]) or Const(String,[]) from cache; ordinary constant inference separately looks up a declaration. Some reconstruction or a returned literal type does not establish valid declarations or whole-export acceptance.

str_lit_to_constructor returns None unless both flags are true. With both flags it needs cached Char, Char.ofNat, List.nil, List.cons, String.ofList, then builds a list in source character order with u32 Unicode scalar Nat literals. Even the empty string follows all five cache prerequisites. Return Some means syntactic construction only.

Private/crate-internal reconstruction feeds conversion, projection and recursor reduction reached from public declaration checking. None locally declines expansion or retains the major; it is not itself a public declaration rejection, and another route may determine the final result.

reuse_assessment.other_retained_patches: Inference-cache and reserved-namespace tests target unrelated boundaries; no mixed Nat/String policy contribution is supplied by them.

This blocks a claimed end-to-end regression here but does not block internal helper construction, whose actual prerequisites are five cached names. Keep declarations absent in both source-designed fixture states.

selected_deliverable.priority: A small held-local preventive regression after separately bounded implementation and fresh source/duplicate/capacity review.

Positive Some structure and exact Unicode scalar order are an independent regression property beyond existing literal creation/interning coverage and beyond an undocumented None observation.

finite_controls.names_present_both_flags_enabled: For empty payload require Some(App(Const String.ofList [], App(Const List.nil [0], Const Char []))). For Aé𝄞 require Some with three cons cells, one Char.ofNat applied to each NatLit Unicode scalar in order [65,233,119070], then List.nil Char. Verify every constructor head, universe argument and application arity by destructuring; do not build expected output by reusing conversion helper.

finite_controls.positive_requirement: At least one exact Some structural/payload result is required. Comparing two None values cannot establish success.

review_resolution: Initial independent preference for a documentation question assumed a complete-declaration positive control was required. Source review of the proposed internal shape assertion established that declarations are irrelevant to this helper contract; explicit axis clarification and positive structural checks support the internal regression without that public-validity assumption.
